Our protagonist you can move up, down, left, right and their respective diagonals, you can defend yourself with punches, kicks, blows to the neck and the deadly blows.

In each of the phases our hero will have to eliminate all the rull enemies, with an incredible ability not to be slaughtered.

Our energy will decrease with each blow we receive and we will have of three initial lives that will be added to those that we receive during the game.

DRIVING
""""""
For the management of our hero we can use the joystick or the keyboard, if we do it with the latter, our keys will be the following:

Q - Up
Down
O - Left
P - right
ESP - Fire
ESC - Pause

Defensive moves: Without the fire button pressed.

Our protagonist will walk up, down, etc. depending on the key pressed.

Offensive movements: With the fire button pressed.

- Left or right, depending on whether we are on the right or left and we will kick and punch.

- Upstairs, we'll hit the neck.

- Down, we will deliver the fatal ax blow.

The ax is our indispensable weapon although we will not start with it from beginning of the game but we will achieve it by passing the first phase.

183667.overview: In Autocrash the player competes in a death tournament between "bumper cars". The goal is to dismount the opponent (or opponents) from his car, and hit him before he leaves the game zone. Along the stages, the enemy's A.I. difficulty level and his number will increase. Additionally, in some stages the enemies must be eliminated in a certain order.

186748.overview: Advanced Mathematics for the ZX Spectrum is an educational math program for teens. It was developed by Robin Alcott and published by WH Smith in 1983.

191974.overview: ABYDOS is a Spanish language platform game developed entirely in BASIC. It was developed and published by J.B.G.V. in 2013.

193473.overview: Aliens are invading Earth!!!!..... again... A group of courageous spacemen has been sent to reject the attack, but the last chance for mankind is in your hands. You, a brave pilot, has been recluted to control ARCOS, the ultra-secret ultimate weapon. Your mission, easy to understand but hard to achieve: Kill the aliens and save the spacemen. With the power of ARCOS lead us to the victory!!! Your mission is to kill all aliens on the screen and save many spacemen as possible. You control ARCOS, a spaceship which bounces an energy ball that destroys everything in its path. If you miss the ball, you lose one life; you begin with 5 lives. In addition, ARCOS has a laser blast with limited ammo. Initially, you've got 10 shoots, but you can get extra ammo when you clear a stage, depending on the number of spacemen you've saved. Use this weapon with caution... it's limited and it can kill spacemen too.

194009.overview:
You are an experimental aircraft test pilot in the Kingdom of Elicor.

Your unit were hosting a visit of the heir to the throne when the call came through - the elderly Queen of Elicor has died of natural causes, and the forces of the evil Prince L'thargy have descended upon Coranon Palace, to place his rotten posterior upon the throne.

As enemy forces attack the airfield, you take off in your prototype helicopter, with none other than the true Heir Apparent onboard. Soon after, you realise - yours was the only  aircraft that made it out intact.

194015.overview:
Help lieutenant Ashley to beat the greedy corporation, space beasts and the crazy computer!
Don’t let aliens reach the earth! 
Long pre55 the "Grenade" button to throw grenades further.			
Press "Down+jump" to jump off boxes.
Beware of doors controlled by the mad computer and try to trap facehuggers under them.
Interact with blinking objects by pressing the "Up" button.
You can stop fans for a while by throwing grenades into them.

194104.overview:
Its All Hallows eve...
Deep in the vast forest kingdom there is a dark, dank tower. Within its walls was sealed the evil Dark Forest Lord. Ancient Sages used the powerful magic of the Moonstones to capture this great evil. After a thousand years however the magic of the Moonstones is fading. They need to be re-energised by another magical creature. As a forest spirit you feel that magic fading. Pumpkin! you have been chosen to stop this fiend before he escapes his prison! Brave the creatures already drawn to this evil place and find the Moonstones, one touch of your magical spirit will bring them back to life!

194105.overview: Alter Ego is an action puzzle platformer. In this game, you control a hero and his phantom 'alter ego' that mirrors all your moves (either horizontally or vertically) from across the screen. You can switch between the hero and his alter ego a limited number of times in each level, in order to avoid enemies and reach inaccessible places. The aim of the game is to collect all purple and green boxes which can be picked up by a hero or his phantom respectively.

194107.overview:
Another Brick On The Wall 2 is a game based on the typical brick crusher, whose main exponent is Arkanoid. The game is a continuation of the one submitted to the BASIC de Bytemaniacos contest in 2004, having been the winner in the "simple" category.

ABOTW2 is made up of 25 levels that we will have to overcome to finish the game. To make it more complicated, a couple of characteristics have been added: when you have been on the screen for a while, new bricks will start to appear randomly and our paddle will advance positions, making it more difficult to reach the ball in time to bounce it again.

194108.overview: Another adventure of the intrepid Indiana Jones, whose goal is to find the ancient cup of Koo-Ram Kar. Legends say that the one who possesses this artifact will never crave food or drink. The road to the temple leads through a jungle fraught with traps, venomous snakes, swarms of wildebeests and other dangers. During the trek, Indiana constantly loses energy, which he must replenish by finding provisions left behind by previous explorers. The player, being in possession of a cup, will not need to consume food to survive, and the decrease in energy will then depend on contact with dangerous animals and traps. The mission will be successful if Indiana delivers the chalice to the truck located at the beginning of the trek.

194109.overview:
Tucked inside his spacecraft, gliding through a dark, icy and lifeless immensity, corporal Jonlan thinks again to the last look he gave to his comrades while leaving from the Zanklé Rebel outpost, towards a mission as vital for the cause of the Rebels as dangerous for his own life. He had volunteered himself for carrying it out. Some of the best Rebel secret agents had paid with the extreme sacrifice in order to gain the necessary information, and this weighed on him, the veteran of many battles,
like a heavy burden.
Jonlan’s destination: Apulija-13, a small rocky planet in the constellation of Cancer, hosting a base where sinister military experiments are being conducted by Omni Corporation. A menace to the Rebels, that’s for sure, but also an unprecedented opportunity to definitely turn the tide of the conflict to their side. By infiltrating inside the base pretending to be an Omni inspector, Jonlan’s task
is to steal the plans of the fearsome mass destruction weapons the evil conglomerate is working at, and at the same time to sabotage the base beyond repair by placing an explosive charge in the power generator.
Time passes… Apulija-13 is near. Bringing abruptly his attention back to the present, Jonlan tunes in the base radio frequencies in order to ask for the authorization to land, but the command console’s loudspeakers only emit static noise. Nothing comes up on the video screens. Jonlan tries other frequencies, but to no avail… until, for just a handful of seconds, some strange, rapidly moving shapes make their appearance on the smooth, cold surface of the display. A shout is heard:
‘They’re here… here they come… aaaarrghhhh…’
Gunshots, more cries. Then the signal breaks.
The Rebel leader hesitates. Although many times he already escaped a seeming unavoidable end, he wonders whether, under such uncertain circumstances, it would be wise to carry on with his mission.
His doubts are swept away by a powerful bio-psionic energy ray, coming from an unknown part of the Omni base, hitting the spacecraft with a terrible force. The automatic landing procedure does not start. Jonlan deactivates the autopilot and overrides it with the manual controls, but the spacecraft’s nanoreactor has been damaged and the engines are losing thrust. The small planet’s surface comes nearer…
The corporal puts his feet on the dusty ground of Apulija-13. He has managed to arrive there alive, but his ship cannot take off without a new nanoreactor. Walking through the airstrip, towards the base entrance – which doors are wide open, while the red lights flash in a frantic way – he can perceive in the distance, among the craters scattered on the horizon, grotesque forms with a vague human appearance menacingly moving… towards him.

194110.overview:
I will tell you a tale about a little boy.  A little boy which was not like the other children, a boy who seemed to belong to another world…

He had no apparent friends, and it looked like he was not ever going to have any. However, he had a special friend, a friend he met only in dreams. In strange dreams like a beautiful book, full of dangerous adventures. In a magical world, where strawberry jelly grows like flowers. In a world where you can also fly. In a world where everything is so easy and simple. The boy lived only in a dream ... Such people are called the "DreamWalkers".

This is a story about one of them.

Collect all of jellies in the level to proceed to the next. You can swap with you friend a limited number of times to reach otherwise inaccessible areas.

194135.overview:
Year 2298, at the dawn of the XXIV century; when humanity has achieved important technological and social achievements, achieving let everyone care about the welfare of all their members and the ecosystem in which they live, being able to eradicate the human behavior negative instinctual acts such as hatred and violence by genetic and neuro-surgical means (after much fighting for a absolute change of mentality and as a consequence of thousands and thousands years of suffering bloody and stupid wars motivated by their own stupidity of man), although it had not yet managed to end all petty crimes such as theft or careless petty theft, even as new scientific investigations have been initiated. Without, However, the clearing of the seas and seabed from waste, non-recyclable materials and debris that man himself, consciously or unconsciously, has been spewing into the ocean for centuries. An evil that many scientists and engineers have dedicated part of their lives to finding solutions to repair this ongoing environmental damage. 

Among them, a highly qualified team of people from the Institute Tecnológico del Mar based in the city of San Francisco, California, had created a series of robots with a high AI coefficient, programmed to remove any residue from the seabed human, who have been named Aquanoids. The ecosystem of these seas has suffered greatly over many decades, however both underwater fauna and flora have managed to stay with difficulty in balance, despite the constant contamination. These underwater robots have been especially designed and manufactured to withstand the high pressures of large depths, only being able to reach a maximum of 3,500 meters below sea level. They are carefree with humans and even constantly ironize their attitude, making jokes and telling anecdotes about his relationship with them, but when It is about preserving the seabed from the hand of man, it is they deliver 100% in their work. They are self-sufficient and possess a autonomy of up to five weeks of operation, thanks to some specific high power generators for them.

194275.overview: Space police they said, you will see the world they said and that is how you ended up in the cat rescue patrol. You will have to travel through space in search of those lost cats that no one has been able to recover and finally give them the life they deserve.

194278.overview: When radiation spread through town and mutants invaded the streets, Maggie and her faithful feline Alphonse were among the few who managed to survive. Now, momentarily safe inside a bunker, Alphonse must go to the surface and find the transmitter located on the other side of the city to get help.

194294.overview:
Now time for the ZX Spectrum to get in on the action, the 1981 Arcade fixed shooter by Sega has been converted by Matt Jackson over to the ZX Spectrum.

The player controls a ship which can fire and move left or right. The player must continuously monitor the onscreen temperature and fuel gauges; if the ship overheats, its weapon is disabled, and if it is depleted of fuel, the vessel itself explodes. The player must battle through waves of enemies, which attack with varied formations and flight patterns to reach the mothership!

194295.overview: You control Brian Bentley, a space explorer who was sucked into an intergalactic portal and taken to a kind of labyrinth shaped like an astronaut. The objective? Collect 6 parts of an astronaut and find the battery to make the exit open and escape from there.

194402.overview: A supercomputer in the most remote part of a distant galaxy has become crazy and threatens to destroy the planet. You have been chosen to be the central link of the support command which will try to give a solution for it. But don't worry, you have been educated and trained in the Golden Ring space station, the hardest survival school of the galactic confederation. Besides, your ship is equipped with the ultimate devices which will allow you to travel safely by the well-known universe. The Combat Mode, where you can activate a panel with a system to locate and to destroy your enemies and the Control System via Menus, both make La Aventura Espacial a new concept in the graphic-conversational adventure. First of all, your mission is to find your companions, whom are distributed by all the universe, and together with them you must arrive to the central base of the Dark Threat. There, you will have to deal one on one with the computer. It's not an easy task, but you are the last hope of the humanity. All the galaxy has its destiny in your hands.

194420.overview:
Axel is a young guy from the county of Daraxian (don't confuse with Radaxian!). One day, on his way to work (Axel is not a prince like his cousin Alex, so he must have a real job) some ugly birds stole him a few bills. Strange but well... bad things can happen.

The next day the daraxian Ministery of Economy contacts him for a Tax Inspection. This is suspicious! The evil finance minister, Mr. Burnstoro, is behind all of this.

Help Axel to find the 15 lost bills spreading around Daraxian. Go inside the ice caves, visit scary places and survive collecting your bills. Don't let Mr. Burnstoro win!

194421.overview:
You don't know the rock pub Azzurro? Rock music, music videos... the best nightlife!... without forgetting the devilish championships of speed and precision in the noble art of drinking.
Will you be able to follow the rhythm and drink the colors according to the indicated sequence?
Become the king of the rockiest night with Azzurro 8-Bit Jam!

The moment has arrived. You must put all your metal senses at the service of your mental agility and speed. At the beginning of each challenge there is a sequence of colors. You must drink as many rounds as indicated on the round counter, following this sequence of colors strictly.

194788.overview:
In this top-view shooter with similarities to Gauntlet, Mr. Weems has set out to kill the She Vampires in their mansion, which is split into six levels. These include many locked doors for which keys must be found, plus teleporters and secret paths.

Weems' main foes are bats and monsters, strategically placed inside coffins, and regenerating when you re-enter a room. Contact with these drains his blood, although fortunately there are replacement vials of this to be found. He is armed with a garlic-firing gun, plus limited numbers of garlic pills, which make enemies avoid him.

The first five levels feature the objects required to kill the She Vampires — a crucifix, large garlic piece, stake, mirror and mallet. Once they are killed, he must make his escape, facing all those bats and monsters again.

195430.overview:
Adventure 200 is a text adventure for multiple systems.

Agents from the land of Grunlock have stolen the kingdom's five royal treasures, leaving the head of palace security in disgrace. The player must dress as a peasant and explore the land to recover the diamonds, gold, royal seal, enchanted mace, and ring before they dare to return to the king in his palace. The player must explore a dangerous desert, twisty mazes, a haunted castle, and other dangers on their quest.

All commands are via VERB NOUN entry, and there is a save/restore feature.

195431.overview: The Amulet is a traditional text adventure where each location is described by text and you use the keyboard to type in commands to interact with each location. The objective is to locate seven shard of a shattered amulet which are scattered through time.

195432.overview: Antares is a horizontally scrolling shooter similar in style to Uridium, where you can choose a ship, and you have to match the height of the enemies to destroy them.

195433.overview: Simulation of slot machine. Player throws several coins in the slot and begins his career. During the improvement of his skill player completes CASH'n'GRAB feature, where he must collect numbers chosen during gambling to complete all letters. Completing this feature, player is allowed to choose one from three bonuses (Pick a Win, Fruit Step, Win Spins) or three misses (Skill Stop, Cash Pot, Hudge Pot). Also he tries to complete CASH RUN feature. During every steps of gambling player can cancel gambling or collect feature. Finishing the career player updates his bank (in UK pounds).

195434.overview:
The sequel to Archon, Archon II: Adept features a more complex board and enhanced gameplay.

Each side plays as an Adept - a powerful wizard with the ability to cast spells against other Adepts and his summonings - and must defeat the other side, either Chaos or Order, by attacking him/her with summoned Elementals or Demons. Each side can summon 4 unique elementals at a time or choose from 4 demons, common to both.

Gameplay is similar to the original, reminiscent of a chess-like board game, requiring strategy, but with arcade elements, especially when two adepts confront each other face-to-face. The board also shifts from time to time, making the strategy less predictable.

Archon II: Adept was released part of the Archon Collection on the Spectrum.

195435.overview: Arcturus is a 3D, 2 player game (player vs player) or (player vs machine) or (machine vs machine) A 4 x 4 x 4 Cube game in which you must get 4 in line to win.

195436.overview: "Averno" is the Spanish adaptation of the skill game Neptune, originally released for the MSX computer. In both the adaptation and the original, the character must be guided through a maze, collecting items to advance through the level. One of the game's unique features is the ability to advance by moving blocks that block the way, allowing you to create shortcuts to obtain these items.

195437.overview:
A top class criminal has stolen the complete American nuclear defence plans. Clearly he holds the fate of the world in his hands. The man is called Atlas.

To catch Atlas and retrieve the plans, an agfent of the highest level is needed. Do you fit the bill? Use your cunning and skill to find the thief, but beware, there are three actual shootouts to win on the way.

195438.overview: In Austerlitz - 1805 the player can command either Napoleon's French army or the Austro-Russian army under the command of Kutusov. The Battle of Austerlitz was fought on 2nd of December 1805, and was Napoleon's greatest victory.

195439.overview:
This game is based on the sport Australian rules football, or Aussie rules. It has two teams playing against each other in four, three minutes quarters and the aim is to score the most points at the end of the game to win.

A goal, also known as a sausage roll, is scored if the ball goes through the middle posts and is worth six points while a behind is scored if the ball goes between the side posts, this is worth one point. You can earn possession by tackling the opposition to win the ball. There is also a chance that while in possession you can drop the ball which may cause you to lose possession. Throughout the game, a commentator runs down the action and gives updates on the scores as they happen.

The game comes with two leagues. The Outback Amateur League has you in control of the Koalas and you must win matches to move up the OAL ladder. You take on teams such as the Rangers, the Butchers and the Wallabies and you must reach the top of the ladder to become champions. The Victorian Football League is the professional league and provides a much tougher test. Here you are the Hawks and teams like the Bombers, the Kangaroos and the Blues are your opposition and the aim is the same as the previous league, win matches to move up the VFL ladder and eventually reach to top to win the championship.

195443.overview: The object of the Auto Chef is to trade profitably so that the company accumulates sufficient capital (£25 million) to take-over T.H.F.! From information supplied you have to decide on which type of outlet to operate, the price of the menu, whether to enter into loan contracts or purchase consignments of food or wines and the level of advertising, wages and dividends. Decisions also have to take into account differing levels of inflation each year. You are warned that if results and dividends are insufficient to satisfy the shareholders, you will be made to resign! There are levels of difficulty.

195799.overview:
Compilation of three games:

BMX Ninja:
The game objective is to survive for as long as possible. To proceed to the next location, you must dismount 8 BMX bikers. Ninja Scooters and Skateboarders do not count towards this total.

Microball:
Pinball game. Hitting various targets on the pin-table will increase the
bonus and hitting all 5 drop targets on the left of the table
will advance the bonus multiplier.
If the bonus multiplier is on 5X and all 5 drop targets are hit,
then an extra ball will be awarded.

Eliminator:
Pilot your Skystrike Attack Craft to the vicinity of the
Motare Nebulae (Galactic co-ordinates - 1711.3, 9215.99 mark 1.763).
Discover why several ships have vanished without a trace.
Intelligence probes sent to the area discovered two types
of enemy craft code-named "Killer Bubbles" and "Mutant
Craft", before being destroyed. Don't let these
names fool you; they are deadly.

195892.overview:
Set in between the SSI's AD&D Dragonlance action games Heroes of the Lance and Shadow Sorcerer. This game follows the tradition of Heroes of the Lance with a side-scrolling, action-oriented view, a breakaway from the standard GoldBox RPGs. Plot-wise, it also takes place between those two games, following closely the novel/game modules written by Weiss/Hickman.

You take control of one character at a time, with each hero having different abilities.

196775.overview:
Addicted to Fun: Ninja Collection is a collection of three games:

-  Dragon Ninja
-  Double Dragon
-  Shadow Warriors

198546.overview:
Spectrum Micro Chess is a 1-2 player chess game released in 1983 by Arctic Computing.

It is the followup to their 1982 game Spectrum Voice Chess.

198622.overview: A Tangled Tale is a text adventure heavily inspired by Alice in Wonderland, it was developed and originally self-published by D. Watson in 1985, it was later re-released by Pocket Money Software in the same year.

198641.overview:
A Toda Maquina II is a Spanish compilation of four games:

Altered Beast (Activision)
Galaxy Force (Activision) 
Operation Thunderbolt (Ocean)
Chase H.Q. (Ocean)

199818.overview: You are Jane Jelly, a treasure hunter. Your mission is to explore the caves of Spectrum and find the treasure of Zedin! Besides the treasure you will find 25 valuable relics. Also you have to find 3 keys. Open the doors with the number of keys requested. But your task will not be easy...in your way you will find many cave hazards that could kill you.

199819.overview: After successfully locating the treasure of Zedin and returning it to her father's friend, Jonathan, Jane has been assigned another mission. Enter the dangerous "Forest of hot marmalade" and bring home its lots treasure! From Jonathan's research, it seems that Jane will need to locate 10 different rune keys in order to access the final treasure room. The forest is fully of wild creatures, deadly plants, poachers, quicksand, skeletons, terrible traps and more. Complete the game by finding the treasure and making your way to your trusted jeep.

199820.overview: Jane Jelly is on Badass Guys Island to find the Egg Diamond and then leave the island with her clothes on. On her third and most dangerous mission, Jane Jelly must travel to the island and overcome the complicated tasks required to retrieve the Egg diamond within the enemy base, hidden in a chest. The second greatest chest on the island, now that Jane is here.

199951.overview:
It's a time in the distant future when an ice age has wiped out all but a pocket of humanity. Races of mutant birds with devilish intelligence have evolved and are trying to wipe out the humans. They attack in waves, dropping eggs on parachutes which bury themselves in the soil and then hatch out as large mutated Hawks to regroup and attack later in waves. The humans have found an old Asteroid Mining Vehicle which is equipped with a powerful missile launcher, a short range laser and a mine layer. Now it's up to you!

A large mutated Hawk screams at the top of the screen, forming up the first attack wave of smaller birds. These can be shot out of the sky with the missiles, but soon they are dropping their eggs. You can shoot these too, using the missiles and lasers, in between dodging the swooping birds. The eggs which successfully reach the ground burrow in and you must lay a mine over their nest before they hatch, which blows them up when they emerge. Those that you fail to kill fly off, although you can still get them if you're quick before they disappear off the screen to wait their moment.

200066.overview:
Playing as England or Australia, you must win a Test match.  If you don't know the rules of cricket, this probably isn't the game for you. Suffice it to say that there are ten venues in which to play the match - five in England and five in Australia. Each pitch has its own characteristics and suits different types of play. The teams are made up of six batsmen, one all-rounder, a wicket-keeper and four bowlers. Three types of bowling are permitted: fast, seam/swing and spin. Teams may be named as you wish, although the computer already holds the names of some already.

The toss takes the form of alternating the names ENGLAND and AUSTRALIA on screen and stopping at random. The winner of the toss can then elect to bat or bowl first. Field placement is done by showing the outline on black and the possible positions in purple. There are more positions than you have in your team, of course, the idea being to say yes or no to each in turn until all eleven team members are where you would ideally like them.  The field then turns green and ready for play.

For each over, a ball must be selected (players 8 to 11). A ball is specified by its line and length and entered as a two-digit number. The batsman has seven types of stroke, from defensive through to off-drive. A stroke is played by pressing the appropriate key for the type of play desired while the ball is bowled. The path of the ball from bowler to batsman is shown so that the batsman has a few seconds to decide what shot to play, and then the path of the ball after batting is also shown.

A captain may declare if he wishes. Weather may interrupt play, and rain is likely to alter the characteristics of the pitch.

200331.overview:
Disco Santa is the dancing queen but his unbridled enthusiasm is distracting him from collecting presents he needs to deliver on Xmas Eve!

What's more, some toys have come alive and become hazardous! Yikes!

Play as the ever helpful Quantum Sheep(!) and pick up the presents for Santa!

202908.overview: Aliana, first human and xenoform hybrid coming from the planet Atlas, takes her spaceship to start a personal fight with the only help of her navigation system aLMa to rise as the only queen and achieve the races balance. She must carry out 3 purges, the first one, in the human investigation center were all humans have been killed. The second purge will be carried out in Aqueronte planet in the Alien colony while the third and the last purge will take place in the Decoud spaceship; a human spaceship for Aliens transportation. Will Aliana finally rise as the queen?

202912.overview:
Atomix is ​​an action graphics game developing a combination game
ability, speed and readiness of his reaction. The game at the same time
in a non-violent way acquaints the players with the construction of the basic ones
chemical element. The role of the player is within a specified time limit
assemble the right molecule from individual atoms.

203106.overview: A typical arcade game for the Spectrum 48K (no music) / 128K (with AY music) made using AGDX (a modified version of Arcade Game Designer 4.7) and AGDMusicizer II. The main character - the player - is Agent Blue.  Spread throughout multiple parts, corresponding to daytime (1 to 10) and nighttime (11 to 20) rescue missions with each part having 10 playable levels. You play as Agent Blue and must rescue the respective hostage from the clutches of his abductors while avoiding being shot by deadly enemies that are spread throughout the level. Collect the keys to open the door to rescue the hostage, and collect 3 scattered envelopes that contain the code for the next mission!

203583.overview:
Aeon is an action-adventure with platforming elements for the Sinclair ZX Spectrum. It was published by Sunteam in 2018.

Game info:

What we have here is a new way of making a Spectrum game! We have a storyline and we are getting a story told as we are playing the game. There is nine (YES: 9 ..!!) tap files, and five of these contains a constant loading of screens that tells the story, while four of them contains games. It works this way: You load tap 1, and when it is finished loading the story screens, the last screen will tell you to reset the Spectrum and load tap 2. Tap 2 contains the first part of the game, and when completing this you are told to load tap 3 that contains screens and story etc etc…

We are following the Goldenstark family and the story is set on the planet Aeon. In each of the four parts of the game we are playing with different characters from the family. In the first part we have landed on Aeon and we control Jesper Goldenstark in his space suit. Running and jumping in a space suit is not very easy and this has been put into the gameplay. Jesper moves slow so the timing of jumping and passing enemies has to be very accurate to succed.

In part two we are controlling a spaceship seen from bird perspective and the object is to find nine survey spots to check these for crystal deposits. There is a lot of dust tornadoes in this area that has to be avoided. In part three we have to go up, up, up and up on different towers and install dishes on each screen, and the biggest problem here is construction robots throwing out garbage of the windows, but also keep an eye on incoming UFO’s. Part four offers a good old platform game with a lot of running and jumping and enemies to avoid.

The game comes for free with the free online magazine “ZX Spectrum Gamer” issue 5 apr 2018.

Game design, graphics, programming: Paul Weller
AY music and sound effects: Sergey Letyagin

203967.overview:
You are the Rt. Hon. Bob Fossington Kiwi - a freelance mercenary and assassin. He has been hired to infiltrate a colony asteroid that houses hundreds of yukky mutants and confront the dreaded Asteroid Worms and obtain four pages of a manuscript for his employer. To get a page you must gain access to a sub-game by feeding a monster to an Asteroid Worm and then taking it on in mind combat whilst it's got its nose bag on. To do this you must use the 1 - 5 keys to match with the numbers on the screen and once you've made it across the screen then you've done it.

This was given away for free with Crash magazine No.79 (August 1990).

It was also given away in Sinclair User issue 119: Great Eight 8.

203968.overview: This wargame takes it's name from Allied actions during the second World War. Operation Avalanche was the landing of Allied forces on the west coast of mainland Italy in 1943. Accordingly, this is the scenario the game uses. The computer can be set to control either the Allied, German, or no side, and various additional settings with respect to historical circumstances (for example the loyalty of Italian forces to each side) can be made. The main game takes place on a single, scrolling map. Units are represented by icons with no single scale (for instance, a tank icon can represent a division as well as a brigade). The gameplay structure itself consists of various phases, such as air (reconnaissance and attacks), order (for e.g. movement actions) and combat. The latter is used to calculate the results of engagements.

205452.overview:
A compilation of 3 math games for young children developed and published by Widgit Software in the UK, and also published in Denmark by ZX Data.

The three games included are:

1. Adding 
2. Subtracting
3. Ducks (a game that combines both addition and subtraction)

207758.overview: An adventure game part of a 4-part Black Crystal game series. In this, the  third stage of the adventurer's journey, you play the part of the holy questor. You must locate and win all ten of the legendary crystals which, it is said, can repel Satan's evil and purify the world forever. You begin your quest at the holy Temple. A guild of adventurers can be found in the nearby village.

207777.overview: You begin this text only adventure standing by the trading post at the edge of a mighty jungle, where many a bold adventurer has perished. You must avoid and overcome the perils of the fearsome jungle and find your way to the ultimate confrontation to get the treasure and back to the trading post alive.

207829.overview:
Kira and Rika, two girls from another planet are serving their sentences on Earth, fighting crime.

The game has 1 Player and 2 Players (co-op) modes.

207900.overview:
Czechoslovakia 2072. A mafia style crime organization is planning a software attack on a company called Alkohol Soft. Your goal is to infiltrate the mob HQ and destroy their main computer, thus preventing the attack. 

Originally a Slovakian text adventure, this game was translated into English in 2021 as part of the Slovak digital games translation project by the Slovak Games Developers Association and Slovak Design Museum, funded by the Slovak Arts Council.

207902.overview: Originally published in Your Sinclair - within magazine cover tape "Your Sinclair issue 89: Beaut Box 4", this vertically scrolling shoot'em up was created by Simon C. Tillson and Andy Mills.

207945.overview:
Originally published in Crash - within the magazine cover tape "Crash issue 66: Presents 2". The game is a puzzle arcade game and will be loved by anyone whose brain exceeds their brawn. All the instructions and information you could possibly want are onscreen, but here's a brief summary of the game...

The object is to capture yellow energy pills by rolling a ball over them.

The ball heads off around the screen under its own power, and you can only control the ball's path by placing and removing gates to deflect its course by 90 degrees.

Each screen must be cleared of energy pills before the time limit expires. Watch out for other objects called effectors which may speed up the ball, change its path or generally muck it about.

The notion is very easy to grasp, but playing Ball Game is a different matter. You should be able to clear the first few screens on easy level, after just a few goes... but it gets harder!

213357.overview: London is in peril! An Interplanetary Battle Fleet from Mars - whose inhabitants are infuriated by our claims that their planet is dead - has attacked. The Ministry of Defense is asleep, so you have to defend the city with just one missile launcher. You can move the launcher to the left using capital Z and to the right using X. Press F when you are ready to fire. The Aliens descend cautiously at first, but be on your guard. If you let a single ship through, London will be devastated.During the game you score points for each invaders you hit - more points for a ship high in the sky than for one close to the ground.

217916.overview:
Armageddon is a clone of the arcade game Missile Command. In this single screen shooter you are the commander of three planetary defence missile batteries and your mission is to protect six cities.

You move a cross-hair around the screen and fire a limited supply of missiles from each battery aimed to explode in front of approaching nuclear missiles that come from the top of the screen to destroy them. If a nuclear missile hits a city then it is destroyed and once all cities are destroyed, then it is game over.

218851.overview: La Abadía del Crimen (The Abbey of Crime) is a computer video game originally programmed in 1987 by Paco Menéndez. The game was originally conceived as a version of Umberto Eco's book The Name of the Rose. However, Paco Menéndez and Opera Soft received no reply from Eco in order to secure the rights for the name, so the game was released as La Abadía del Crimen. The graphics were made by Juan Delcán. This game is an action adventure with 3D isometric graphics, where a Franciscan friar, William of Occam (William of Baskerville in the book) and his young novice Adso have to discover the perpetrator of a series of murders in a medieval Italian abbey.

218881.overview:
The Axe of Kolt is a fantasy themed text adventure for the Sinclair ZX Spectrum. it was developed by Larry Horsfield and released by FSF Adventures in 1990.

Game description:

The peaceful kingdom of Hecate has been invaded by the Xixon, an evil race of lizard men who have reappeared after all were thought to have been vanquished by the hero, Kolt, over 200 years before. Kolt used an axe, forged from elf metal by a sorcerer, but the axe was buried with Kolt when he died, and the location of his tomb has been forgotten by most folk. Can you, Alaric Blackmoon, once a roving mercenary and swordsman, now just a penniless wanderer, find the lost "Axe of Kolt" and return it to its rightful owner, the young king Kelson of Hecate??

419523.overview:
Animal Vegetable Mineral is a version of an 'after dinner' game in which players have to guess a mystery object by asking questions to which the answer is either Yes or No.

In this game, the player thinks of an object and the game tries to guess it. The game comes with a very limited range of items, 'knowing' just two objects in each category. When the player submits an item the game does not have in its database, the player is asked how the new item differs from the best answer the game could give. This information is then stored, and so the game's repertoire grows.

The game allows the player to review, edit, and store the database.

420770.overview: Amidar is a clone of the GAKKEN tabletop version of the arcade classic Amidar, coded entirely in BASIC for the ZX Spectrum. It was developed and self-published by Salvador Camacho and released on February 26, 2022, originally as part of "Bytemaniacos Concurso BASIC 2022", a Spanish BASIC coding competition.

421682.overview: Angle is an educational game for the ZX Spectrum. The game quizzes the users on their knowledge of geometrical angles. The game was developed and published by Chalksoft in 1984.

421707.overview:
It is three days brefore the flood. 62 animals are hidden within the 256 screens of this game, in a different location every time. Your task as Noah is to find the animals and bring them back to the ark. Not all are willing to go, some you will have to drag by the tail. You have six lives, but only three days.

To add to the difficulty, Noah is not very popular with his tales of doom, so watch out for restive locals who will throw stones if you get too close. For each pair of animals saved, see how history changes!

423925.overview: How many of you remember that highly addictive game whereby you used to fling birds at collapsible objects to knock pigs out of the way? Well I do and it was the gaming fad for the time ' Angry Birds ', which isn't on anyone's mind right now as it's mostly Pokémon Go. But what if we could take Angry Birds and turn it into a shooter for the ZX Spectrum? Welcome to ' Angry Birds (Opposition) ' by kas29.

424554.overview:
A classic shooting game in which you have to shoot down all the aliens. The player's ship has the ability to turn on the dial, and to replenish the batteries you have to catch the falling F letters.

This was  a type-in from Your Sinclair - type-in from issue #2 - 1986/Feb

424584.overview: The player takes on the role of a friendly egg that is tasked with cracking all the codes in Blatchley Park. In some rooms there are different items and you can carry a maximum of three of them.

424585.overview: A puzzle game in which the player's goal is to get the ball to the place with the flag. The game involves choosing the ball's state of concentration (rubber, steel or sticky mass), setting the direction and force of impact, and then launching it. Depending on the settings, the ball will bounce and roll according to the rules of dynamics and until it stops, no action can be taken. The player has a limited number of strokes for each of the focus states. Further down the board, new obstacle elements appear like doors to unlock, gravity switches, kibbles and dangerous objects. The game will end if the player uses all the available strokes for the ball.

424609.overview: The player takes on the role of a friendly penguin, whose task is to reach the exit. Many dangers await on the way, the avoidance of which in many cases requires precision, speed and scheme recognition. Before entering the next board, an introductory intro is displayed. Some rooms additionally require logical thinking, e.g. in the second board you need to take two dynamites to make the cannon shoot the penguin to a safe height. It's worth collecting diamonds that add time, the value of which is a point bonus after completing the level. Sometimes it may seem impossible to complete the level due to the lack of access to the exit. In such situations, look for a place that activates invisible platforms and ladders.

424611.overview:
The player takes on the role of a barbarian equipped with a battle disk and embarks on an unusual journey full of bizarre creatures on an unusual planet. The disk can be thrown up, down and in front of you eliminating enemy creatures. At the end of each stage there is a boss fight. 
 
Published in Magazine MicroHobby - within covertape "MicroHobby issue 202: Tape 27".

424621.overview: A classic shooter in which the player directs a super modern spaceship equipped with plasma weapons to destroy overwhelming enemy forces. During the flight, in addition to enemy units, the player is also threatened by the degeneration of the flora and fauna of the planet on which the battle is taking place. It is worth destroying the purple spheres appearing from time to time, which contain a module for strengthening the weapons you have. Collision with the elements of the environment does not take away the energy you have, but sometimes it is effective in making it difficult to escape from projectiles and collision with an alien craft. A total loss of energy will result in the destruction of the ship, and despite having fifteen such units there are times when you can lose them all. At the end of each stage, the player will have to fight a battle against a powerfully armed and resilient opponent.

425180.overview:
Aliquid Simplex is a maze collect 'em up for the ZS Spectrum. It was developed by David Aspinall, and published in Your Computer issue v.4 #11 - 1984/Nov.

Game description:
Guide poor professor Hilfe around his laboratory, which has been set on fire after his generators failed.

His only chance to save his labe is to get his robot Frankie to help him.

Unfortunately, all the parts of Frankie are scattered about. Hilfe will have to collect them and take them to Frankie's bed.

PLEASE HELP HILFE!!!

448780.overview:
Arkanoid 2: Revenge of D'oh clone programmed in BASIC.

Ball movement in 4pixels.

30° , 45° and 60° bounce angles.

7 types of PowerUps.  
 
Contestant at Bytemaniacos Basic contest 2022
You have to guide the shovel-shaped craft through 17 phases, trying to destroy the bricks of each screen, using a ball that hits them bouncing on the shovel. If the ball goes down the bottom line you'll lose a life.

449142.overview:
Welcome to A Case of Murder. You are Sam Boon an L.A. Private Detective (or so your permit says, as yet you haven't had any cases). You might be a good detective, a great detective or a total flop, your actions will decide your future.

The time is around about midday on the 1st of June 1968. You have just moved into your new premises to setup shop. Everything is poised to begin.

451128.overview: A game for two players, in which the competition takes place on a maximum of nine holes. After entering names and selecting the number of holes to play, a top view of the first golf course is displayed. Each turn consists of selecting a golf club and its type, and specifying the direction of the shot in the range from 0 to 359 degrees. After making your selection, you can watch the ball fly. It may happen that the ball hits a tree or lands on unfavourable ground, which will make it a little more difficult to hit from that spot. Once the ball is placed on the green with the flag, the viewing area will change, and you will need to adjust the distance and direction so that the ball falls into the hole.

452210.overview: Anglo Scot is a train simulation for the Sinclair ZX Spectrum. It was developed and published by Dee-Kay Systems in 1987.

453001.overview:
A Serpentine Tale is a fantasy text adventure. In this game the player takes the role of the hero from Zenobi Software's earlier text adventure The Black Tower. The tale starts with the player taking a trip to the City of Hiarken for a sort of holiday.

The bad news is that a day or so from your destination a storm sinks the ship. The good news is that you alone survive in a small boat. The bad news is that a short way into the game a giant sea serpent appears, smashes the boat and swallows you whole.

Unsurprisingly the object of the game is to survive, escape, and make your way to shore.

453306.overview:
Arcadia is a 1989 compilation of three games for the Sinclair ZX Spectrum, all of which were also previously released as separate games by Ocean Software.

The games included are:

- Chase H.Q.
- Operation Thunderbolt
- The New Zealand Story

457277.overview: Autostopista Galáctico is an early arcade-style game released in 1983 for the ZX Spectrum by Ventamatic. In this game, you control a small character trying to hitchhike through space, avoiding obstacles and hostile alien creatures. The gameplay focuses on dodging hazards and navigating moving platforms or vehicles to progress from one side of the screen to the other. It is heavily inspired by classic arcade games like Frogger, but set in a science-fiction universe. The graphics are simple, colorful, and typical of early Spectrum titles, offering fast-paced, reflex-based action rather than deep story or puzzles.

462514.overview:
The player's task is to guide five people across the river using a swinging rope. Generally, you need to press any key at the right moment so that the person running grabs the rope. A failed attempt will result in falling into the water. The game ends after all people are lost and the number of points scored is displayed.

The game was a type-in from the 1983 book "The Spectrum Book of Games".

463296.overview:
Acheton is a home computer conversion of the mainframe adventure of the same name. Similar to Zork (which was released on the VAX mainframe not long before Acheton's original appearance), it is a fantasy treasure hunt set in a claustrophobic dungeon. It boasts over 400 rooms and 200 objects, thereby making it much bigger than Zork.

As with many games of this kind the most time is spent by exploring the environment and solving item-based puzzles. Everything is described solely with plain text and the player interacts with the game by typing in phrases which describe his desired action, e.g. "take bottle". It also features a help function with graded hints.

463305.overview:
As a lone pilot in the far uncharted reaches of your galaxy, you clash with the might of an alien onslaught. Fearing for the lives and riches of your homeland you arm the laser cannon and prepare for attack.

As you destroy each aggressive force a new more skilled and more determined fleet appears. Learning from past errors they attack with wave after wave of lethal craft.

Your laser cannon must not overheat, listen for the warning as a total malfunction could mean your doom. After successfully destroying an armada you must calmly but quickly dock with an abandoned supply vessel.

463503.overview: Earth, the year 3025. After surviving a series of global catastrophes, humanity managed to avoid extinction and build a truly perfect society. But suddenly, a new threat emerged. Through a wormhole, Earth was drawn into a war between two powerful civilizations controlling thousands of galaxies beyond the visible part of the universe. The small planet held no interest for them, but the people caught in the crossfire faced total annihilation. Humanity had nothing to counter the aggression that had descended upon them. There was only one option left: to try to survive. Billions of cyborgs living alongside humans were retrained for a new task — the art of war...*

464042.overview:
You are the captive of an ancient, warlike alien race. Like the Romans they play games with their captives, games with a very final outcome... Death.

At first there's silence, you grip your deflector shield. Suddenly screaming out of the sky comes a comet, your arm instinctively goes up to protect yourself and the comet is deflected. Seconds later it's at you again from another direction and again you deflect. Then you notice something strange. The spiked walls seems to come nearer... and they are getting nearer all the time.

464091.overview:
In this adventure you take the role of Eric Bean, the wily gnome.

You find the Valley of Gnomes is strangely quiet.  You must explore...

If you can find ferret, you will have a useful but mischievous ally against the Goblins or Murgar Mountain...

464741.overview: The player begins their adventure in the port city of Athens, and their task is to visit various islands in the Aegean Sea in search of treasure. On each island, the player receives a clue as to whether the island contains treasure or a monster. Deductive reasoning must be used to determine what each island contains. If the player crashes their ship on land or discovers an island with a monster, it is destroyed. Sailing is made difficult by storms that occur from time to time and Zeus throwing thunderbolts. The player starts with three ships, and if all of them are lost, the game is over. The treasures obtained are exchanged for drachmas, which are necessary to buy a new ship.

464760.overview:
A shooting game in which you must use a sight to destroy aeroplanes and the bombs they drop. With every second that passes, the city's points and energy decrease. Each aeroplane or bomb you shoot down increases these parameters. If a bomb falls on the city, its energy also decreases dramatically. The game ends if the points or energy fall below zero. 
 
Published in the Spanish type-in magazine MicroHobby, from issue #36 - 1985/Jul.

466903.overview:
Using two plots located on the left and right sides and with the help of a sight, you must use lasers to destroy incoming alien ships that want to destroy the defended building at all costs. As you progress, new alien ship designs will appear. 
 
Published as part of the compilation "MicroHobby Semanal 033-036".

470870.overview:
Alien Attack 2: Invaded colony is an action arcade game published by MANSoft. The setting involves a colony that has been invaded by alien creatures. The game features side-scrolling levels where the player character confronts various alien enemies and obstacles.

The upper part of the in-game screen shows the layout of rooms and corridors, with hostile alien entities and barriers. The interface at the bottom of the screen displays the player's remaining lives, a health bar, and an ammunition counter.

The game is structured around the task of navigating the invaded colony, eliminating threats, and progressing through interconnected areas. The player encounters alien adversaries guarding certain passages and must manage resources displayed on the status bar.

471490.overview:
Awari is a traditional board game played in Africa and the Caribbean.

The game starts with four seeds in each house. The objective of the game is to capture more seeds than one's opponent. Since the game has only 48 seeds, capturing 25 is sufficient to win the game. Since there is an even number of seeds, it is possible for the game to end in a draw, where each player has captured 24.

472267.overview: You're a mouse whose job is to collect pieces of cheese. You must watch out for snakes, spiders, and other cats. Encounters with them can be fatal.

474403.overview: This is the second time that Archon was ported to the ZX Spectrum. The first port was published by Ariolasoft UK and released in 1985. This port was published by Electronic Arts and released as part of the Archon collection. The two ports are unrelated to each other.

474502.overview:
Aliana, first human and xenoform hybrid coming from the planet Atlas, takes her spaceship to start a personal fight with the only help of her navigation system aLMa to rise as the only queen and achieve the races balance.
New features compared to the original game  "Alien girl":

- EASY MODE is included.

- Includes 4 new levels. The first two contemplate substantially different scenarios and the last level presents a new perspective on the original.

- Different gameplay: Doors need several shots to open, fewer initial lives for Aliana, although you can resupply throughout the game, limited time in the first two levels (you can take extra time throughout the game), the Queens have more lives , among other little things.
